name: Kenji "NightCode" Verma

power.name: Recursive Insight
power.description: Sees patterns others miss, but at the cost of solitude. Each pattern decoded pulls him further from the people who can't see it.

tagline: He had built things people used but never known.
backstory: Gifted child, labeled early, trained for excellence that nobody defined for him. At 12, he solved a problem his tutors couldn't. At 22, he watched someone half as sharp get promoted above him. He went quiet. He went underground. He's been building ever since — in silence, in rented rooms, under a handle his family wouldn't recognize.

rival.name: The Polished Clone
rival.description: Credentialed, well-spoken, produces half the insight in twice the words. Loved by everyone who doesn't look closely.

mentor.name: The Tired Veteran
mentor.description: Peaked fifteen years ago. Fell further. Shows up when Kenji is about to give up, says two sentences, disappears.

final_form_locked: Final Form: The Unseen Architect — unlocks after Episode 6.
opening_line: In a city of noise, he coded in silence — waiting for the one problem that would force him to step into the light.
